evidence: The microstructure and interface morphology of ZrO2 were investigated using XTEM (JEOL2010). The surface morphology was analyzed using an atomic force microscope (AFM). Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) were utilized to analyze the chemical composition variations and impurity contents. The electrical properties were characterized using the Keithley 590 analyzer and semiconductor parameter analyzer (HP 4155A). The interface state density was calculated from the high-frequency C–V data using the Terman method.
